## Notes

- Licence features (2026-11-13): HSM, Performance Replication, DR Replication, MFA, Sentinel, Seal Wrapping, Control Groups, Performance Standby, Namespaces, KMIP, Entropy Augmentation, Transform Secrets Engine, Lease Count Quotas, Key Management Secrets Engine, Automated Snapshots, Key Management Transparent Data Encryption, Secrets Sync, Secrets Import, Oracle Database Secrets Engine, Azure Secrets Engine, SPIFFE Auth Engine, SPIFFE Secrets Engine, OpenLDAP Secrets Engine, PKI External CA Secrets Engine, Okta Auth Engine, Consumption Billing, Agentic IAM.
- Profile read: {"issuer_id":"https://vault-1:8200/v1/probe-1794564551/identity/oidc","user_claim":"user","actor_claim":"act.sub","unique_id_claim":"jti","jwt_type":"access_token","optional_authorization_details":false}.
- Q6: a Vault identity token (no typ header) is not taken for an OAuth JWT: the refused read's audit entry has no auth block: {"error":"1 error occurred:\n\t* permission denied\n\n","auth_display_name":null}. Only one profile may name an issuer (duplicate issuer_id refused).
- Q6 answered: a delegation token works when the booking app signs it with a non-exportable Vault Transit key (typ at+jwt); no signing key exists outside Vault.
- Q7: Keycloak 26.8 also lists federated-jwt: a client may authenticate with a JWT from a trusted issuer; a Vault identity token (short-lived, from the app's own Vault login) could replace the booking client secret. client-x509 (mTLS with a Vault PKI certificate) needs Keycloak restarted with Vault's issuing CA in its truststore and HTTPS client auth on; that is built and measured in prompt 07. Until proven there, the booking client secret stays a residual.
- Q9: LocalStack accepts any access key on this token: it is a place (a copy, a Sync target), never a credential test (D12 holds).
- Q11: the capabilities each step needs are the rows above (database creds, wrapped secret-id, pki issue and revoke, ldap static-cred and rotate-role, identity/oidc/token, kv read under RAR) plus the bootstrap policies in vault/policies/bootstrap/; make boundary proves them per token.
- Q12: every refusal above is quoted verbatim in its row.
